name: Foxfire
oracle_text:
Untap target attacking creature. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by that creature this turn.
Draw a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
blocked_sentences: Untap target attacking creature. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by that creature this turn

needs.what: a `combat_only: true` option on the `prevent_damage_permanent` op (and its PermanentShield), so a resolving spell can prevent only COMBAT damage dealt to and dealt by a targeted permanent this turn, leaving noncombat damage to and from it untouched
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `prevent_damage_permanent` with `dealt: to_and_by` and `duration: this_turn` is the right shape but PermanentShield has no combat filter, so it would also prevent noncombat damage (burn, fight, pingers) -- a strictly different card. The `prevent_damage` static has `combat_only` but is continuous on a printed permanent, cannot be installed by a spell for one turn, and only stops damage dealt TO what it matches
